about.note: Hidden answers. dbt and Power BI must never read this file. Money in EUR. true_money_per_shop_month uses what actually happened in the simulation (including fraud not yet reported); months are the month of the payment's first try. true_fix_values_per_year are expected values computed from the rules (no random noise), as the change versus the actual 2025 setup.

true_effects.local_bank_note: average gain in first-try approval rate for NL/DE/FR cards now at a foreign bank, if sent to their local bank
true_effects.retries_note: average gain in final approval rate for payments with retries switched on, versus the same payments with retries off (customers retrying themselves)

true_fix_values_per_year.note: Change in expected platform profit and shop sales per year versus the actual 2025 setup. local_routing: NL/DE/FR cards to their own country's bank, other cards to Bank NL (cheapest). Repricing: see true_shop_year break-even price.
